Name: 1.6 Seasonal Outfit's Sprite patch for Petite's Alex Remake
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is a compatibility patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9849]Petite's Alex Remake[/url]﻿ Seasonal sprites which adds compatibility with the newly added 1.6 Seasonal Outfits Slightly Cuter Aesthetic sprites for festivals.

This mod includes sprites for the: Egg Festival, Luau, Moonlight Jellies & the Ice Festival.

[b]*You will need to install the original[/b] [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9849]Petite's Alex Remake[/url][/u] [b]mod to get access to the original sprites*[/b]
[list=1]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Petite1002/mods?gameId=1303]Petite[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9849]original mod[/url]﻿ and giving permissions to users to make a 1.6 compatibility patch with Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic, as long as you only add the new sprites and require the original mod to work

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for the incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ mod, with the original amazing sprites and some portraits, and for the generous open permissions allowing users to create/use artwork from the mod without asking for direct permission as long as credit is given [i](although note that[/i] [i]only artwork made by Poltergeister in Slightly Cuter Aesthetic is free to use[/i][i] and to check which portraits were made by which artists before releasing[/i]) - allowing this mod to be possible! Thanks again Poltergeister! :D

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
